visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The screen displays a high-resolution split-screen graphic of a woman's face to demonstrate skincare results. The left side features 'before' images highlighting skin concerns: red bumps on the cheek, wrinkles under the eye, a shiny T-zone, and scalp flakes. Each concern is labeled with text and associated with specific ingredient combinations like '果酸+A醇' via white arrows. The right side shows clear, smooth 'after' skin. The woman has dark hair and neutral facial expressions in the small inset photos. (2) The visual transitions to a minimalist logo screen with a light gray background. Subtle diagonal white rays emanate from the right, creating a sense of clean professional branding. A black stylized 'DR' logo is centered, followed by the brand name in both Traditional Chinese '達特仕保養品' and English 'DRX Series Skincare' in a clean sans-serif font.
